data.title: The Digital Cage
data.narrative_purpose: Establish Elena's new, clandestine operation and her fierce determination to uncover the truth, highlighting her isolation and the shift to an off-grid investigation.
data.location: Elena Vasquez's Apartment - Makeshift Command Center
data.camera_style: Slow push in, close up on Elena's face, emphasizing isolated intensity, reflections in pupils.
data.color_palette: Intense, cool blue light from monitors, deep shadows.
data.lighting: Dominant cool blue light from screens, casting stark, long shadows across the room.
data.visual_motif: Screens glowing, tangled wires, reflections of scrolling data.
data.music: Subtle, anxious synth pulse begins to emerge, very low in the mix.
sound_effects: Low hum of server fans and power supplies
Rhythmic, rapid clicking of Elena's keyboard

data.title: Architect of Deception
data.narrative_purpose: Show Elena's increasing frustration as she encounters an advanced, systemic form of digital obfuscation, hinting at a higher, more sophisticated adversary.
data.location: Elena Vasquez's Apartment - Makeshift Command Center
data.camera_style: Static wide shot of Elena and screens, then close-ups on her jaw tightening and fingers flying with precision.
data.color_palette: Colder, more impersonal blues and greens from screens, highlighting the vastness of the system.
data.lighting: Harsh monitor glow, creating a clinical, almost sterile environment around Elena.
data.visual_motif: Complex, alien code; elegantly obfuscated data streams, geometric patterns of network traffic.
data.music: Synth pulse intensifies slightly, becoming more dissonant, a low thrum of frustration.
sound_effects: Whirring of hard drives growing louder

data.title: Watching Back
data.narrative_purpose: Introduce the terrifying realization that Elena is being observed and targeted, escalating the paranoia and confirming an unseen entity's presence.
data.location: Elena Vasquez's Apartment - Makeshift Command Center
data.camera_style: Slow push in on Elena, emphasizing her isolation. Quick cuts to unsettling visuals: a fleeting shadow, a reflection in a dark screen. Dutch angle to enhance unease.
data.color_palette: Dark, with stark contrasts from the screen glow, emphasizing the surrounding unseen network.
data.lighting: Low ambient light, screen glow, subtle play of shadows suggesting hidden movement.
data.visual_motif: Reflections, shadows, a faint flicker on a static screen like a ripple in water.
data.music: High-pitched, almost subliminal frequency briefly cuts through, then fades. Unsettling drone.
sound_effects: Subtle, almost inaudible 'click' or 'ping' from an unknown source

data.title: The Machine's Signature
data.narrative_purpose: Mark a shift in time and Elena's progress, as she identifies the source of the anomaly within a government infrastructure, revealing the scale of the operation.
data.location: Elena Vasquez's Apartment - Makeshift Command Center
data.camera_style: Static wide shot establishing the mix of dawn light and screen glow, then focus on screens displaying complex network topology and Elena's focused expression.
data.color_palette: Grey dawn light filtering in, mixing with cold screen glow, shifting to starker red and black on monitors, indicating danger and secrecy.
data.lighting: Natural dawn light filtering through blinds, mixing with the intense, cold glow of the screens.
data.visual_motif: Complex, interconnected network topology diagrams; an obscured server farm icon within government infrastructure graphics.
data.music: The anxious synth pulse from the previous scene is now a steady, driving beat, a relentless rhythm of discovery.

data.title: Project Phantom
data.narrative_purpose: Deliver the central revelation of the identity swap, shifting the narrative from a hack to a deliberate, deeper conspiracy involving a classified project.
data.location: Elena Vasquez's Apartment - Makeshift Command Center
data.camera_style: Close-up on Elena's hands hitting ENTER, then a sustained shot of the screen reveal, followed by a close-up on Elena's face as color drains, emphasizing her physical reaction.
data.color_palette: Stark white text on a black screen, pale skin tone of Elena, contrasting with the warm, gentle tones of Sarah Jensen's photograph.
data.lighting: Screen light illuminating Elena's shocked face, creating a clinical and revealing glare.
data.visual_motif: Stark text on screen, a faded photograph, Elena's reflection in the dark bezel.
data.music: Driving synth beat abruptly cuts out, leaving a sudden, deafening silence. Then, a slow, mournful, almost hollow piano chord begins to play.

data.title: A Stolen Life
data.narrative_purpose: Explore the immediate emotional fallout of the revelation, emphasizing Elena's shattered reality, profound isolation, and the existential dread of a stolen identity.
data.emotion: Despair, profound betrayal, existential dread, emptiness
data.location: Elena Vasquez's Apartment - Makeshift Command Center
data.camera_style: Slow pull back from Elena, then a close-up on her wide eyes, reflecting the glowing screen with Sarah Jensen's photo and the 'reassignment' text. Subtle visual distortion ripples across the screen.
data.color_palette: Desaturated, cold, emphasizing the alien and unfamiliar feeling of her own apartment.
data.lighting: Dim, with the screen glow as the only significant light source, creating a sense of profound isolation.
data.visual_motif: Reflections, distorted images, familiar objects now appearing alien and questioned.
data.music: Mournful piano chord holds, then slowly fades into a low, unsettling drone.
sound_effects: Elena's ragged breathing subsiding into a stunned silence
data.transition_in: Slow pull back from previous scene
